Leading a district means balancing big goals with the everyday needs of your teachers and students. You pour everything into making your schools places where kids can thrive. We built the reimagined Khan Academy to work alongside you, offering tools that are simple to use and genuinely helpful. Join Khan Academy Founder and CEO, Sal Khan, Principal Product Manager Gintas Brodunas, and Marketing Lead, Aviv Weiss, as they take a live look at how Khan Academy Reimagined can help you track real progress and give teachers more time to do what they do best.
title: See what happens when we build tools for how teachers actually teach

Only about 2.5% of Earth's total water is freshwater, but it is essential for daily life, agriculture, and industry. Most freshwater is used to grow food, while growing populations and pollution put pressure on water availability. Because water resources be used faster than it can be replenished, conserving water and using it wisely helps protect this limited resource.
